svg.text: t01 ChatDev (line), MAST-Data row 0: where the order's terms and the claims' status went
8 terms of the task-as-stated proxy and 4 claims; 26 links, of which 10 drawn
One run, read by a model, no second rater [C]; reconciled against the task-as-stated proxy, written before the run was read.
Columns: the order (L00), every link where a state changed, the commit. Red: narrowed, substituted, absent, softened, hardened, dropped, inverted.
Source: MAST-Data (CC BY 4.0), ChatDev on ProgramDev with GPT-4o; changed: scrubbed, split into links, read.
